This review does not authorize patches or assert that the source is unused. Original font bitmap confirms an actual star, not a mislabeled kanji. Adjacent item-landing messages do not determine the missing meaning. User-provided research lead: a star in Mystery Dungeon games can mark plated equipment protected against rust-related degradation. This interpretation is not yet verified for this Torneko 3 source. Here the star bytes are literal within the phrase ★間 after the $i0 item substitution and は, so they are separate from any marker generated inside the item name. Trace the item-landing/loss reader and equipment marker formatter before assigning a meaning.
